### Defying Gravity
Author: Katherine Britton
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-nov-4-2009-11610725.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 29:14
Points:
- Clinging to material possessions creates a heavy gravitational pull that traps our hearts in worldly concerns.
- Releasing wealth and possessions to advance God's kingdom brings genuine freedom rather than feeling like a loss.
- David was deeply humbled not simply by his wealth, but by the privilege of being able to give generously back to God.
- True Christian joy is found when we acknowledge that all we have comes from God and willingly return it to Him.

### Reveling and Resting in the “Godness” of God: Praying through 1 Chronicles 29:11-12 (ESV)
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/reveling-and-resting-in-the-godness-of-god-praying-through-1-chronicles-2911-12-esv/
Passage: 1 Chronicles 29:11-12
Points:
- Everything in creation belongs to God, exists for His glory, and is sustained by His power.
- Earthly rulers and kingdoms are fleeting, whereas God's sovereign rule is eternal and supreme.
- Every blessing, possession, and position in our lives is received directly through divine providence.
- The same sovereign hands that hold ultimate cosmic power are joined to a heart full of fatherly love and generosity.
